What is invoice automation
Invoice automation uses software to capture, validate and route supplier invoices without manual data entry.
Benefits
It reduces errors and speeds up payment cycles.

Approve invoices faster
Set approval rules so invoices route to the right approver automatically. Reminders stop approvals from stalling.

Pricing
Plans start at a flat monthly fee per user. Annual billing lowers the price.
Enterprise
Custom contracts and volume discounts are available.

Security and compliance
We encrypt data at rest and in transit. SOC 2 audits happen yearly.

Integrations
Connect your accounting software, ERP and bank feeds through our API.

Automation versus manual invoicing
Manual invoicing means keying data by hand which is slow and error prone. Automation removes the keying.

About the team
We are a small company that builds finance tools and loves coffee.
